aboutGame.title: What This Template Includes
paragraphs: This mother template provides the static framework for a game wiki: homepage modules, category pages, MDX article rendering, breadcrumbs, table of contents, JSON-LD, canonical URLs, sitemap generation, robots.txt, legal pages, and optional analytics or ad hooks.

Child sites should replace the template copy with real game data before launch: game name, domain, hero image, trailer, official links, homepage modules, keywords, article content, contact email, and advertising keys.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common launch checks for child game wiki sites built from this template.

items.question: Can this mother template be deployed as-is?
items.answer: It can build as a static site, but a real child site should replace the game copy, domain, media, homepage modules, content, contact email, and optional analytics or ad environment variables before public launch.

items.question: Where should new game content go?
items.answer: Create MDX files under content/en/<content-type>/<slug>.mdx. Each article should export metadata, start body content from H2, and target one search intent.

items.question: How are URLs generated?
items.answer: English public URLs stay unprefixed. Category pages use paths such as /codes, /guide, /bosses, and article pages use /<content-type>/<slug>.

items.question: How do analytics and ads work?
items.answer: GA4, Clarity, AdSense, and Adsterra slots are controlled by NEXT_PUBLIC_* environment variables. Empty values render no script and no ad DOM.

items.question: What must pass before deployment?
items.answer: Run type checking, static export, sitemap validation, internal link checking, and desktop/mobile visual checks for affected public pages.
